title: 第1099章 狐火认主第1098章 先祖之火择主而事
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: 他周身气息虽未爆发，但那平静话语中蕴含的、源自大日圣体与神焱的绝对自信，竟让周围躁动的火海都为之一静！
“你！”涂山焱被噎得一窒，脸色涨红，周身火焰气机升腾，眼看就要爆发冲突。
“够了！”雪姒疏清冷的声音响起，带着高阶妖皇不容置疑的威严，瞬间压下了场中剑拔弩张的气氛。
她美眸扫过涂山焱和姚德龙，声音平静却蕴含力量：
“先祖有灵，自有决断。与其在此争执，不如平心静气，各凭本事，看那缕惊鸿老祖之火究竟会选择谁。
我们退开一旁，让火焰自行选择，如何？”她最后的目光落在涂山焱身上。
涂山焱看着雪姒疏那不容置喙的眼神，又看了看姚德龙那深不可测的平静，
心中虽万分不甘，却也知道此刻动手毫无胜算，反而可能惊扰火种。
他咬了咬牙，最终冷哼一声：“好！就依圣女之言！我倒要看看，他一个人族，凭什么得到惊鸿老祖的认可！”
说罢，与涂山烈退后几步，死死盯着火海深处。
姚德龙淡然一笑，也负手而立，目光投向那缕沉睡的帝王之火。
一时间，整个本源火海仿佛都安静下来，亿万火焰摇曳生姿，如同屏息等待帝王的抉择。
那缕沉浮于火海极深处的、带着统御气息的火焰，仿佛彻底苏醒了！
它先是微微震颤了一下，似乎在感应着什么。
下一秒，在所有人难以置信的目光中——
轰！
那缕火焰猛地爆发出前所未有的璀璨光芒！
它不再有丝毫犹豫，如同一道划破天际的流星，带着煌煌帝威与迫不及待的欣喜，
径直越过了盘膝而坐、心神早已与之沟通、脸上写满势在必得的涂山焱！
在涂山焱瞬间变得惨白、扭曲、充满了绝望与不信的表情中，
那缕象征着天狐族无上火道荣耀的惊鸿族长之火，带着温顺与臣服的姿态，
轻柔而又坚定地……悬浮在了姚德龙的掌心之上！
火焰流淌，如同温顺的精灵，散发出无比亲昵的气息，仿佛找到了最终的归宿！
寂静！死一般的寂静！
涂山焱如遭雷击，整个人僵在原地，看着姚德龙掌心那缕温顺的、本该属于他涂山焱的无上圣火，
大脑一片空白，嘴唇哆嗦着，却一个字也发不出来。
他引以为傲的天狐第一火道天骄身份，他视作囊中之物的惊鸿传承，
在这一刻，被这缕火焰的选择，无情地、彻底地踩在了脚下！
涂山风张大了嘴，涂山战和涂山岩也是目瞪口呆，连雪姒疏的眼中都掠过一丝惊讶，随即化为更深的骄傲。
“夫君，你……”雪姒疏看着那缕强大到令她都心悸的神火乖巧地停在姚德龙掌心，一时也有些失语。
这可是惊鸿老祖的本源火种啊！绝对是这本源火海中最顶尖的存在！
然而，更令所有人意想不到的事情发生了。
姚德龙低头，看着掌心这缕雀跃的、蕴含着磅礴力量与无上火道传承的圣火，
眼中闪过一丝欣赏，却没有丝毫贪婪。他轻轻一笑，如同拂去一粒尘埃般随意，五指一松！
“去吧。这里，才是你真正的归宿。”
嗡！
那缕惊鸿族长之火猛地一颤，似乎极为不舍地在姚德龙指尖缠绕了一下，
content_en:
Although the aura around him did not explode, the absolute confidence contained in those calm words, derived from the Holy Body of the Sun and the Divine Flame, actually silenced the restless sea of ​​fire around him!
"You!" Tu Shanyan was choked, his face flushed, flames rising around his body, and a conflict was about to break out.
"That's enough!" Xuesi's cold voice sounded, with the unquestionable majesty of a high-level demon king, instantly suppressing the tense atmosphere in the field.
Her beautiful eyes swept over Tu Shanyan and Yao Delong, and her voice was calm but powerful:
"The ancestors have spirits and make their own decisions. Instead of arguing here, it is better to calm down and rely on their own abilities to see who the ancestor's fire will choose.
How about we step aside and let the flames choose? "Her last gaze fell on Tu Shanyan.
Tu Shanyan looked at Xue Sishu's uncompromising eyes, and then at Yao Delong's unfathomable calmness.
Although he was extremely unwilling to give up, he also knew that there was no chance of winning if he took action at this moment, and it might disturb the fire.
He gritted his teeth and finally snorted coldly: "Okay! Just follow the words of the saint! I want to see how he, a human race, can be recognized by the ancestor Jinghong!"
After that, he and Tu Shanlie took a few steps back and stared into the depths of the sea of fire.
Yao Delong smiled indifferently and stood with his hands behind his hands, looking at the sleeping emperor's fire.
For a moment, the entire sea of ​​​​original fire seemed to be quiet, and billions of flames swayed, as if waiting with bated breath for the emperor's decision.
Buzz—!
The flame that floated in the deepest part of the sea of ​​​​fire, with a commanding aura, seemed to have completely awakened!
It trembled slightly at first, as if it was sensing something.
The next second, in the eyes of everyone in disbelief——
Boom!
That wisp of flame suddenly burst out with unprecedented brilliance!
It no longer hesitated at all, like a meteor streaking across the sky, carrying the imperial power and impatient joy,
He walked straight past Tu Shanyan, who was sitting cross-legged and had already communicated with him in his mind. His face was full of determination to win!
Tu Shanyan's expression instantly turned pale, twisted, full of despair and disbelief,
The Jinghong Patriarch's fire, which symbolizes the Supreme Fire Dao glory of the Sky Fox Clan, with a meek and surrendered attitude,
Gently but firmly...suspended in Yao Delong's palm!
The flame flows like a docile elf, exuding an extremely intimate atmosphere, as if it has found its final destination!
silence! Deathly silence!
As if being struck by lightning, Tu Shanyan froze in place, looking at the gentle wisp of the supreme holy fire in Yao Delong's palm that should have belonged to him, Tu Shanyan,
My mind went blank, my lips were trembling, but I couldn't utter a single word.
He is proud of his status as Tianhu's No. 1 Fire Dao Prodigy, and the Jinghong inheritance he regards as his treasure.
At this moment, he was ruthlessly and completely trampled under his feet by the choice of this flame!
Tu Shanfeng opened his mouth wide, Tu Shanzhan and Tu Shanyan were also dumbfounded, and even Xue Sishu's eyes flashed with a hint of surprise, which then turned into deeper pride.
"Husband, you..." Xue Sishu looked at the divine fire that was so powerful that it made her heart palpitate and stopped obediently in Yao Delong's palm, and she was speechless for a moment.
This is the original fire of ancestor Jinghong! Definitely the top existence in this original sea of ​​fire!
However, something even more unexpected happened.
Yao Delong lowered his head and looked at the joyful holy fire in his palm, which contained majestic power and supreme fire inheritance.
There was a flash of appreciation in his eyes, but there was no trace of greed. He smiled softly, as casually as brushing away a speck of dust, and relaxed his fingers!
"Go. This is your true destination."
Buzz!
The fire of the Jinghong Patriarch trembled violently, and seemed to wrap around Yao Delong's fingertips with great reluctance.
